articles.title: Tokenization and stablecoins may weather Democrats' sweep as broader crypto rules face uncertainty
articles.snippet: Wall Street's push to bring finance onto blockchain rails may continue under existing laws, though the SEC and CFTC face tougher oversight and questions over how long their rules will last, experts said.

articles.title: Circle’s ARC token sale lifts earnings as lower yields weigh on USDC income
articles.snippet: Circle is looking to payments fees and future staking rewards to diversify revenue as its core stablecoin business faces pressure from lower yields and growing competition.

articles.title: What Is x402? How AI Agents Pay With Crypto
articles.snippet: Coinbase's x402 protocol puts the web's long-unused 402 code to work so AI agents and apps can pay for APIs and data in stablecoins like USDC.
